Name: Aphek in Bashan
ModernLocation: Disputed; Tel Ein Gev or Fiq, Golan Heights
Description: The Aphek east of the Sea of Galilee where Israel fought Aram: Ben-hadad's army was defeated there under Ahab, and Joash later struck the ground there before defeating Aram.
BiblicalSignificance: It is the battlefield of two Aramean wars, showing God's deliverance of Israel from a stronger Aramean army.
